name: authority
description: The console's own control objects: realms, roles, policies, sessions and signing keys.

resources.name: assignments
resources.description: Who holds which role, and where that holding came from.

resources.name: clients
resources.description: The registered applications that request tokens from this authority.

resources.name: credentials
resources.description: The passwords, keys and factors an identity authenticates with.

resources.name: elevations
resources.description: Time-bound approvals that raise a session's assurance for a sensitive action.

resources.name: grants
resources.description: Application scopes a customer has authorized, and can revoke.

resources.name: identities
resources.description: The people and services this authority recognizes as principals.

resources.name: impersonation
resources.description: Acting as another principal for a demonstration, which only the simulator is permitted to exercise.

resources.name: keys
resources.description: The key set this realm publishes for verifying its own tokens.

resources.name: permissions
resources.description: Every `resource:action` a resource server has declared it enforces.

resources.name: policies
resources.description: The attribute-based rules that narrow or withhold what a role would otherwise allow.

resources.name: providers
resources.description: External or federated identity sources a realm trusts.

resources.name: realms
resources.description: The organizations that group this authority's own configuration.

resources.name: resourceServers
resources.description: The applications, tools and MCP servers that have registered a permission catalog.

resources.name: roles
resources.description: Named bundles of permission a principal can hold.

resources.name: sessions
resources.description: Active and lapsed sign-ins across this realm.

resources.name: tenants
resources.description: The partition a realm's data is isolated under.

resources.name: creditAssessments
